استقطرا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَرَا (istaqṭarā) /is.taq.tˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# اُسْتُقْطِرَا (ustuqṭirā) /us.tuq.tˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# اِسْتَقْطِرَا (istaqṭirā) /is.taq.tˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
